It sounds incredibly stressful and isolating to experience this kind of hostility in your workplace, especially in a field so focused on empathy and connection. Having your personal political affiliation impact your professional relationships and client retention is a heavy burden to carry. 

Deciding whether to stay or leave is a deeply personal choice. Since you suspect the tension might ease after the election cycle, it could be helpful to evaluate the overall culture of your practice. Outside of this current political climate, do you feel supported and valued by your colleagues? If the foundation of your workplace is strong, it might be worth waiting to see if the environment improves. However, if this experience has permanently shifted how you feel about your comfort and belonging at work, exploring opportunities in a community that feels more aligned with your values could offer greater peace of mind. Trust your instincts and prioritize what will best support your professional growth and personal well-being.
